purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Liupanshui’s municipal real-property registry and land registration services are confirmed by city and provincial-government materials, but no anonymous public parcel-geometry service was identified. No property-owner, address or account lookup was submitted. No full geometry sample was retained.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Liupanshui Natural Resources Bureau 2023 budget performance document explicitly names the city bureau’s Real Estate Registration Center, registration-certificate issuance and “Internet + real-estate registration” service work.

Liupanshui Municipal Government Gazette describes registration services, including city/county centralized service halls and first registration of land parcels; this evidences local registry workflow, not public GIS geometry.
Official city Natural Resources Bureau procured a city basic surveying and mapping plan, providing evidence of municipal mapping administration but not a cadastral parcel feed.
Official Guizhou natural-resources statistics include city-level Liupanshui property registration certificate and mortgage activity; corroborates ongoing city registration operations.
